tagline.zh: 全能变形职业，可覆盖坦克、治疗与输出。
tagline.en: Versatile shapeshifter covering tank, healer and damage roles.

strengths.zh: 职责最灵活，想换玩法不必重练。
strengths.en: Most flexible class; swap roles without rerolling.

drawbacks.zh: 样样通但上手复杂，装备需求分散。
drawbacks.en: Jack of all trades; complex and gear-hungry.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Class list and roles per Blizzard class deep-dive posts; tree data extracted from beta client.
